name: Instapaper Premium
tagline: The core loop is small enough for a capable coding agent to produce a useful local version in one sitting. For Instapaper Premium, save readable versions of permitted pages, highlight them, and search the archive. The hard boundary is mobile capture, sync, text-to-speech, kindle integration, and parser maintenance, plus capture polish, sync, and content partnerships.
